labels.text: Section 55(d)(2): the exemption amount is reduced by this percentage of the amount by which alternative minimum taxable income exceeds the threshold. 25 percent in the 2024-Edition text; 50 percent for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025 by section 55(d)(4)(A)(ii)(IV), added by Pub. L. 119-21 section 70107(c). The pinned text carries no earlier figure, so years before 2012 are not covered.
section 55(d)(2): "25 percent of the amount by which the alternative minimum taxable income of the taxpayer exceeds"

Pub. L. 119-21 section 70107(c) (139 Stat. 163): section 55(d)(4)(A)(ii)(IV) "by substituting '50 percent' for '25 percent'", applicable to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025 (the pinned 2024-Edition text of section 55(d)(4)(A)(ii) has no subclause (IV))
